products.label: GPX10 PRO
products.description: GPX10 Pro brings fully programmable, always-on AI to wearables, hearables, smart sensors, and other power-constrained edge devices.

products.label: GPX40
products.description: GPX40 combines sustained vision with integrated wireless connectivity for camera-first smart glasses, safety helmets, and wearable cameras.

products.label: GPX80
products.description: GPX80 delivers advanced perception and control for microdrones, compact robots, automated inspection, and in-cabin intelligence.

products.label: GPX Ultra
products.description: GPX Ultra provides Linux-class AI performance for autonomous drones, AMRs, and advanced robots requiring real-time vision, navigation, and multimodal sensor fusion.

applications.heading: Build the impossible. Today
applications.subtitle: Don't let legacy design tradeoffs limit your roadmap. Discover the market-differentiating features of GPX10 Pro and what's coming next.

feature_cards.title: Continuous Biomarker Tracking
feature_cards.description: Run ECG, glucose, and health-signal intelligence directly on the device for early anomaly detection without draining the coin cell.

feature_cards.title: Always-On Safety Monitoring
feature_cards.description: Enable fall detection, acoustic assault monitoring, and activity intelligence that runs quietly in the background with zero cloud latency.

feature_cards.title: Local FaceID & Presence
feature_cards.description: Recognize users and trigger appliances locally, without sending visual data to third-party cloud servers.

feature_cards.title: Offline Voice Control
feature_cards.description: Execute natural language commands for locks, thermostats, and home devices even without internet dependency.

feature_cards.title: Predictive Maintenance
feature_cards.description: Process vibration and acoustic telemetry directly at the machine edge to detect faults before downtime begins.

feature_cards.title: Visual Defect Detection
feature_cards.description: Run continuous inspection on factory-floor camera nodes without flooding networks with raw image data.

feature_cards.title: Tire Pressure Monitoring
feature_cards.description: On-device air pressure and temperature sensors provide real-time alerts for tire health to prevent accidents and optimize maintenance and fuel expenses

feature_cards.title: Battery Management
feature_cards.description: Monitoring of cell utilization, charging patterns, heat generation, etc. in electric vehicle batteries to prevent mishaps and optimize battery life

feature_cards.title: Real-Time Anomaly Detection
feature_cards.description: Continuous biometric signals can be processed locally to detect irregular patterns faster, without depending on cloud connectivity.

feature_cards.title: Miniaturized Monitoring Devices
feature_cards.description: Run clinical-style monitoring in compact form factors where battery life, privacy, and instant response matter most.

feature_cards.title: Remote Visual Monitoring
feature_cards.description: Deploy low-power vision intelligence in fields, farms, and remote environments where cloud access is unreliable.

feature_cards.title: Behavioral Tracking
feature_cards.description: Track livestock movement and behavior locally to detect health, safety, or activity changes without constant data transmission.

feature_cards.title: Autonomous Navigation
feature_cards.description: Process object detection and movement awareness directly onboard to support faster, more responsive flight decisions.

feature_cards.title: Flight-Time Efficient AI
feature_cards.description: Run local intelligence without sacrificing critical battery life, keeping drones airborne longer while reducing cloud dependence.

feature_cards.title: Always-On Wake Words
feature_cards.description: Run continuous wake-word detection and voice commands locally inside earbuds without draining the tiny audio battery.

feature_cards.title: Adaptive Voice Isolation
feature_cards.description: Separate the user’s voice from noisy surroundings in real time, directly on-device, without relying on phone or cloud processing.
